_doc: Raven skin palettes. Ramps are dark→light and every source region is remapped along its luminance ramp, so shading is kept. Regions: skin (her grey face / legs and the grey silhouette lines inside the Soul Shell) — NEVER recoloured; outline + black shell disc / dark-magic hand — kept; cloak (purple cloak, hood, leotard); boots (cloak-coloured pixels in the lowest 12 px band of each grounded body frame; falls back to cloak when a skin gives no boots ramp); gem (chakra + belt gems, red); fx (Dark Pulse orb + Energy Exploding). Brick piles / breaking stay natural stone. Read by tools/raven/build_skins.py, which also writes ravenSkinTable.js.

skins.name: White Light
skins.inspiration: Raven's white cloak after Trigon's defeat (Teen Titans 2003, S4 'The End, Part 3'; also the white-cloak 'purified' Raven of the comics)
skins.research: The white cloak marks Raven freed from Trigon's influence; the gem stays red and her skin stays grey in every white-cloak appearance.
skins.notes: Cloak / hood / leotard white-lavender, boots soft grey-white, gem kept red, magic pale gold-white.

skins.name: Trigon's Ember
skins.inspiration: Trigon's red skin, black horns and four golden eyes; Raven's corrupted / 'Trigon's daughter' palette
skins.research: Trigon is crimson-skinned with yellow eyes; Raven's demonic form is often drawn with red / black cloth and glowing marks.
skins.notes: Cloak blood-red to black, gem burning gold, magic ember orange. No horns or extra eyes are drawn.

skins.name: Scarlet Hex — Scarlet Witch Inspired
skins.crossover: Marvel — Scarlet Witch (Wanda Maximoff) colour inspiration
skins.inspiration: Scarlet Witch crimson costume and red hex magic
skins.research: Wanda's modern look is crimson / scarlet with a darker red cape and red-pink hex bolts.
skins.notes: Cloak crimson-scarlet, gem pale rose, magic hex red-pink. No tiara or headpiece is drawn.

skins.name: Hollow Violet — Hollow Purple Inspired
skins.crossover: Jujutsu Kaisen — Gojo's Hollow Purple colour inspiration
skins.inspiration: Blue (Lapse) + Red (Reversal) merged into an imaginary-mass violet
skins.research: Hollow Purple is drawn as a deep violet sphere with blue and red fringes; the palette keeps her cloak violet but pushes it toward that saturated imaginary-mass tone.
skins.notes: Cloak deep ultraviolet with a blue boots band, gem red-to-blue split read as magenta, magic electric violet.

skins.name: Alien X — Inspired
skins.inspiration: Alien X's black starfield body with white edges and green-white eyes
skins.research: Alien X is a living starfield: a black body, white outline plates and three horns. Only the starfield colour idea is used — no horns and no body change.
skins.notes: Cloak void black with a cold white rim, gem white-green, magic starlight. Cached STAR material (sparse fixed-hash pixels inside the cloak mask, 4 crossfaded phases).

skins.name: Ghostfreak — Inspired
skins.inspiration: Ghostfreak's pale grey-white skin, black chains and single green eye
skins.research: Original-series Ghostfreak is pale grey-white with black / dark-purple markings and a green eye.
skins.notes: Cloak pale ghost grey with charcoal boots, gem ecto green, magic sickly green-white. No chains or new eye geometry.

skins.name: Moonlit Opal
skins.inspiration: Opal gemstone play-of-colour under moonlight (original cosmetic design)
skins.research: Precious opal shows a milky base with shifting blue / green / pink flashes; the cloak is a pearly blue-white and the flashes are a cached iridescent overlay.
skins.notes: Cloak pearl blue-white, gem moon-pink, magic soft cyan. Cached IRIDESCENT material (slow breathe, static under reduced effects).

skins.name: Gothic Velvet
skins.inspiration: Black-burgundy crushed velvet with a faint garnet sheen (original cosmetic design)
skins.research: Crushed velvet reads as near-black with soft wine highlights; a sparse cached glitter adds the sheen.
skins.notes: Cloak black-wine, gem garnet, magic deep plum. Cached GLITTER material (sparse, slow crossfade).

skins.name: Aurora Witch
skins.inspiration: Northern lights over a dark-teal night sky (original cosmetic design)
skins.research: Aurora borealis is mostly green (oxygen 557.7 nm) with violet-pink upper fringes; the cloak is dark teal and the aurora is a cached iridescent overlay.
skins.notes: Cloak night teal, gem violet, magic aurora green. Cached IRIDESCENT material.

skins.name: Sapphire Starlight
skins.inspiration: A sapphire-blue night cloak scattered with starlight (original cosmetic design)
skins.research: Sapphire blue sits around #0F52BA; the deep ramp keeps her silhouette dark and a sparse cached star layer sits inside the cloak only.
skins.notes: Cloak sapphire, gem ice white-blue, magic bright blue. Cached STAR material.
